about.heading: What is 3D printing?
about.p1: 3D printing is a technology for creating physical objects directly from a digital 3D model. By adding material layer by layer, a finished part is produced in a relatively short time, depending on its size and complexity.
about.p2: The method is widely used both for developing prototypes and in real production, in fields such as architecture, industrial design, the automotive industry, aviation, medicine and the creative industries. Our 3D printing services cover parts of varying complexity and size.
about.p3: One of the main advantages of 3D printing is freedom of form – parts with almost unlimited geometry and a wide range of sizes can be made. We offer 3D printing of small batches, prototypes and functional parts in high quality.
